description: Invasion.  Focus on destiny 8 blasters, big drain damage, and WIAPN damage with Tank Commanders.
strategy:
Strat is actually fairly simple, and one I've been following since Invasion came out... but with a few Virtual twists that shore up a few of it's inherent weaknesses.  I'm not going to give a full turn-by-turn until you flip, just because you pretty much have to play it by ear... I'll tell you this much, though; don't flip until you feel that your space force is able to sustain a small/mid-sized beat.  On your first turn, for sure, you need to drop Mob Points to pull SecPrec(V), giving you some extra activation.

A couple of the various nuances that make this deck unique:

Levitation Attack (V) - by keeping those destiny-8 blasters under the shield instead of in the deck, you free up a bit of room for some other stuff.

WIAPN/Tank Commanders - for those that can't count, you're doing an extra 3 damage per turn with this baby.  Woohoo.

Security Battle Droids - why not Infantry droids, you ask?  Because I prefer the movement limitations provided by these things, that's why.

Expand The Empire trick - drop the Expand on the Swamp to add a drain +1 to your other two sites.

That should just about do it.  Like I said, this is a play-by-ear deck, so any detailed strat just isn't feasible.  You're just gonna have to build it and give it a try... if nothing else, it's fun as hell!

***UPDATE***

responses

DrunkEwok - couldn't find a non-combo version (sad, ain't it?).  Besides, the only DDTA they'll be able to cancel with is the non-shield one, and not too many people play that.  Oh yeah, or if they're playing TRM.

As for Guri, 4-LOM, and U-3PO... couldn't fit 'em in.  They're somewhat limited in usefulness anyways.

***END OF UPDATE

Enjoy!

David Kangas
